leftEvidence.title: Paradise opens as corruption ends and immortality appears

points.label: Place prepared
points.left: Paradise is opened, a city is built, and the tree of life is planted.
points.right: The holy city descends prepared as a bride.

points.label: What ends
points.left: Corruption, weakness, death, and sorrow pass away.
points.right: Death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more.

points.label: What is given
points.left: Goodness, wisdom, rest, healing, and immortality are revealed.
points.right: Life-water is given freely and the overcomer inherits.

payload.posture: Hold both Scripture sources together while preserving their participants, setting, sequence, genre, and inference boundaries.

rightEvidence.title: The holy city descends as death and pain end

payload.tension: Both futures end death and suffering around a prepared city, while each scene names a different set of gifts and images.
payload.title: A prepared future and the new city
